overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today, driven by dry 1000-hour fuels (20%) and afternoon low humidity (28%), but conditions are easing fast.**
- Danger drops to Low by Saturday and stays Low through Nov 19 as ERC and BI percentiles fall into the single digits.
- Light snow showers are expected tonight and Saturday, with gusty northwest winds up to 10 mph behind the system.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is active for the area.
- Fire restrictions have eased region-wide: the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre & Gunnison National Forests lifted all restrictions in early September, and Gunnison, Delta, Mesa, Montrose, Ouray and San Miguel counties have since dropped Stage 1/2 orders as cooler, wetter weather settled in.
- No active wildfires are reported in or near Montrose-area counties in today's national incident report; the only uncontained large fire nationally is in Wyoming.
